==English==
[[File:Counts of Mark Arms.svg|thumb|Or, a [[fess]] chequy gules and argent.|135px]]
[[File:Coat of arms of Croatia.svg|thumb|[[wikipedia:Croatian checkerboard|Croatian chequy as part of coat of arms]]|135px]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|checky|chequey}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|xno|escheké}}, {{m|fro|eschequé||chequered}}, from {{m|fro|eschec||chess, check}}. Influenced by {{suffix|en|chequer|alt1=chequ(er)|y}} and {{m|en|check}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈt͡ʃɛki/}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛki|s=2}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-}}

# {{lb|en|heraldry}} [[chequered|Chequered]]; divided into small squares ([[chequer]]s) by [[transverse]] vertical and horizontal lines.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=Thomas Pynchon|title=Against the Day|page=821|publisher=Vintage|year_published=2007
|passage=Sometimes the Princess was seen conferring spiritedly with the Spongiatosta security details posted about the streets nearby, whose livery bore the ancient family arms, a sponge couchant on a field '''chequy''' with flames at the foot.}}
